_comment: Founders, loaded into the CMS (Content → Team) by `npm run seed` if they don't exist yet. Edit them in the CMS afterwards.

members.name: Mose Gebreselassie
members.bio: Mose brings more than ten years of commercial experience in international trade and logistics, quality control and sales. Having lived in more than eleven countries and speaking more than seven languages, he understands your market as well as the origin. He leads our buyer relationships, from the first brief to the repeat order.
highlights: 10+ years in trade, logistics, QC and sales
members.photoAlt: Portrait of Mose Gebreselassie, co-founder of Ethiopian Coffee Sourcing

members.name: Natnael Samson
members.bio: Natnael has lived in Ethiopia for the past ten years and built an extensive network there, which is now at the heart of the company. He is our team on the ground: following your samples, preparing orders for shipment, and making sure what is agreed is what happens.

members.name: Seife Tuuloskorpi
members.bio: Seife was born in Ethiopia in 1967 and grew up in Sweden. After several years in the coffee trade, he founded Seife’s in 2018: an Ethiopian green coffee business that has since generated more than SEK 100 million in revenue, with coffee from washing stations, single farms and estates. Seife’s operations are now becoming part of our company, bringing his relationships at origin with them. His conviction is simple: ethical trade, not aid, and a greater reward for everyone from farmer to roaster.
highlights: Born in Ethiopia, raised in Sweden
